name: IsAnyEdgeIntersect
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesA,verticesB,LET(nA, ROWS(verticesA), nB, ROWS(verticesB), edgeIntersect, REDUCE(FALSE, SEQUENCE(nA), LAMBDA(acc,i, LET(xi, INDEX(verticesA, i, 1), yi, INDEX(verticesA, i, 2), xj, INDEX(verticesA, IF(i = nA, 1, i + 1), 1), yj, INDEX(verticesA, IF(i = nA, 1, i + 1), 2), lineIntersect, {ref}IsPolyAndLineIntersect(verticesB, xi, yi, xj, yj), OR(acc, lineIntersect)))), edgeIntersect))
comment: Returns TRUE when an edge of polygon A meets an edge of polygon B, including a shared vertex or a shared edge. A polygon strictly inside the other, with no boundary contact, returns FALSE. Both arguments are n×2 arrays of (x, y) rows; the last row connects to the first. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
